method: Directly read all24 current KO paragraphs and all24 EN partners, complete outline/intents, current original-source concept notes and sealed source action observations.

sceneReviews.reason: Four natural sentences in three paired paragraphs. Central question is reading the next action when colors differ; promise order is house outlines, plant height/motion, dark-space contrast, with a direct connection to the first house. 20–30s remains a plan.
Observed house/path/window/roof boundaries remain under changing fills. Our diagram explicitly compares outline removal with outline retention, not a claim about every viewer.
Hatching persists under painting/partial erasure. No complete removal claim. Round/angular handles are explicitly hypothetical design examples, not observed Chicory devices.
Observed differently colored mushrooms rise and support bouncing, then compress. Height/top surface/motion supplement hue. No correct-hue requirement, optimal route or all-color guarantee.
Separate painting/erasing shots and plants returning tall illustrate current state. Explicitly rejects permanent-unlock inference and conflation into one uninterrupted action.

Player, top surfaces and destination edge are foreground priorities. Reducing color count alone is insufficient; outlines/shapes help distinguish important roles. Background obscuring the path is a diagram comparison.
Cave has limited pale circle and dark surroundings; no whole-scene brightening claim. Lightness is distinct from hue; diagram compares foreground/background rather than medical thresholds.

Grayscale/color-perception preview helps find problems but does not prove every player can read the screen. Actual target/state/next-action checks and the promised outline/height/contrast cues recur in the conclusion.
